svg.title: System architecture
svg.desc: Two apps share one engine and one database. The live cloud pipeline (EventBridge to Lambda to Lee County APIs and geocoders) and a fleet of collaborator-run crawl workers both write into the same Neon Postgres database; the workers coordinate through a crawl_queries work queue.
svg.text: Bulk historical crawl — collaborators, each on their own IP, self-paced
claim crawl_queries (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) · fetch API · write incidents · fan out children
